title: LifePatch — Gameplay Bed (adaptive)
licenseNotes: Original. Generic tonal voicings (i-VI-III-VII in A minor); no sampled or transcribed third-party material.
sourceNotes: Procedural; phase `menu`/`gameplay` of src/audio/AudioEngine.ts. Intensity driven by debt/health/mood/macro-tone. WIRED: components/run/ConsequenceBeat.tsx snaps its ceremony ladder onto this grid via hooks/useBeatClock — stamp on the ceremony's downbeat, count-up spanning a whole number of beats (the gap between two snapped boundaries), impact landing ON the beat with the `consequence` + stampGood/stampBad stingers requested ACCENT_PREROLL_MS (120ms) early so the engine's 8th-note quantization resolves them onto that same instant. An 80ms HITSTOP separates the impact from its follow-through. Minor-tier beats ride the 8th grid instead (a whole-beat lock would stretch them ~40%). The count-up tick is transposed by juiceTier().pitch (a filter shift on band-limited noise — no note is added to the score). Muted and not-yet-unlocked players get the identical ladder on a local performance.now() grid at the same tempo. See .claude/audio/qc/cue-plan.md.
